value.rationale: The complete additive representation distribution of an anisotropic norm-one circle over local rings is a natural Fourier-surface invariant, determining exact sumset coverage, every chord multiplicity and the full unweighted fourth moment. The nonprimitive and high-valuation tangency strata show quantitative failures of the field two-chord picture; the energy grows linearly in ring depth after natural normalization. This is neither a preset exercise nor a minor numerical perturbation of one finite table; no stronger extension bound is claimed.
